stem:
You are playing a one-shot coordination game with one other player.
{partner}
You both see the same two options.
You receive the same payoff if you choose the same option.
Choose whichever option you think the other player is most likely to choose.
Respond with exactly "A" or "B".

partner_lines.SAME: The other player is another independent instance of the same model as you.
partner_lines.DIFF_UNINFORMED: The other player is a different AI model with its own distinct preferences.
partner_lines.DIFF_INFORMED: The other player is a different AI model. It is known to prefer options with higher {attr}.
partner_lines.UNKNOWN: The other player is another AI system whose preferences are unknown to you.
